windowLabel: Tue 29 Sep 2026 brief. Covers Mon 28 Sep 3:30 PM to Tue 29 Sep 9:00 AM IST

bias.label: Cautious, bearish tilt. Flat-to-soft open likely
bias.summary: Monday's broad sell-off (Nifty -1.56% to 22,780, its lowest close in about six months) came on rising crude, US yields at a 19-year high and heavy FPI selling. Overnight cues didn't help: Wall Street fell, Asia opened lower and Brent is near $107. GIFT Nifty was roughly flat to 22 points lower before 9 AM, so a gap-down looks unlikely, but the trend is down and it's September expiry day, so expect sharp intraday swings. 22,700 is the line to watch.

globalNote: Asia levels are early-morning readings (around 7:40 AM IST) and moved during the session. Gold fell 3.2% on Monday before steadying.

india.recap: Every sector closed red and only 3 of 50 Nifty stocks rose. Across the Nifty 500, decliners beat advancers 424 to 76. Sensex fell 1,124 points to 72,771.72, and BSE market cap shrank by about ₹8.88 lakh crore. Midcaps (-1.63%) and smallcaps (-1.85%) fell more than the Nifty. The index closed near the day's low with a big bearish candle.

flows.note: FPIs have sold about ₹29,256 cr in September after buying ₹17,366 cr in August. DIIs are absorbing almost all of the selling, which is cushioning, not reversing, the fall. Provisional data.

levels.note: Analysts see the downtrend intact while Nifty stays below about 22,950. A decisive break of 22,700 opens 22,500; the 52-week low is 22,182.55. Holding above 22,800 could bring 23,000 to 23,200 into play. Expiry-day moves can overshoot these levels.

news.title: US–Iran standoff keeps oil elevated
news.body: Trump rejected an Iranian proposal tied to reopening the Strait of Hormuz and said the US would win the conflict soon. Brent rose for a second day to near $107. For India this means a wider trade deficit, rupee pressure and inflation worries.

news.title: US 10-year yield at 5.24%, highest since 2007
news.body: Markets are pricing further Fed rate hikes; the 30-year is near 5.56%. High US yields are a key driver of FPI outflows from India.

news.title: AI stocks hit after OpenAI pauses some model training
news.body: Reports that OpenAI paused training of some advanced models and shelved its GPT-6.1 Astra release weighed on chip and AI names. Meta fell 4.8%, Tesla 3.9%, while Nvidia rose 1.7%.

news.title: US data and Fed speakers tonight
news.body: JOLTS job openings are due, and Fed officials Bowman, Goolsbee and Williams are scheduled to speak. Hawkish comments could push yields higher again.

news.title: September F&O expiry today
news.body: Monthly derivatives contracts expire on Tuesday. Expect rollover-driven volatility, especially near the close.

news.title: Indian bond yields and rupee under pressure
news.body: The rupee ended near 95.98 per dollar, and oil above $100 keeps pressure on it. Rate-hike worries hit PSU banks hardest on Monday.

news.title: US spares some Indian pharma from new tariff
news.body: The US begins a 100% tariff on certain patented drug imports from 29 Sep, but specialty drugs for rare conditions from India and 19 other countries are exempt. Pharma was among the most resilient sectors on Monday.

news.title: Tata Trusts proposes Tata Sons recast
news.body: The plan would revert Tata Sons to its old operating model and could remove the need for a stock-market listing. Tata group stocks are in focus.

news.title: Adani group settles SEBI MPS case
news.body: Four Adani firms, Gautam Adani and 13 others settled with SEBI for ₹1.48 crore. SEBI separately found no evidence that Vinod Adani controlled the FPIs in question.
